item.title: AnteoTech Raises $3.5m for Global Commercialisation of Life Sciences and Advanced Battery Technologies
item.description: AnteoTech raises $3.5m to accelerate global commercialisation of life-science and battery tech, targeting partnerships and sales growth.

item.title: Productivity Takes a Holiday
item.description: Productivity Commission delivers 47 reform recommendations for Australia: tax tweaks, upskilling, and data reforms that could boost GDP billions if acted on.

item.title: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Advances Commercial Pathway as AI Platform Validation and Distribution Agreements Gather Pace
item.description: Algorae Pharmaceuticals (ASX: 1AI) advances AlgoraeOS validation and signs Dr Reddy's distribution, signals near-term oncology revenue and stronger balance sheet.

item.title: Sun Silver Delivers New Silver-Gold-Antimony Assays From Maverick Springs Project
item.description: Sun Silver hits high-grade Maverick Springs assays: 102.1m at 86.2 g/t AgEq, incl. 50.6m at 149 g/t AgEq, plus antimony, boosting resource potential.

item.title: Axel REE Delivers Major Resource Growth and In-Situ Leach Breakthrough at Caladão Project
item.description: Axel REE (ASX:AXL) drives Caladão growth: Area B MRE to ~572Mt at 1,506ppm TREO and 439Mt Ga; Woolrich ISR breakthrough with ~464ppm soluble REO.

item.title: NoviqTech Expands into Biochar Carbon Removal with Coralia Acquisition
item.description: NoviqTech (ASX: NVQ) to acquire 90% of Coralia, expanding into biochar carbon removal with near-term credits and data-centre sustainability upside.

item.title: Eden Innovations Strengthens Balance Sheet as EdenCrete And OptiBlend Sales Momentum Builds
item.description: Eden Innovations (ASX:EDE) cuts debt by ~$16m, raises $4.35m; EdenCrete & OptiBlend momentum builds as it targets positive cash flow in 2026.

item.title: Boss Energy Reports Strong Production and Reduced Costs at Honeymoon Uranium Project
item.description: Boss Energy (ASX:BOE) posts a Honeymoon quarter record: 456,000lb uranium concentrate, 406,000lb IX, and lower C1 costs to $30/lb, with FY guidance of 1.6M lb.

item.title: Mount Ridley Mines Announces Maiden Scandium MRE at Flagship Mount Ridley Project
item.description: Mount Ridley Mines (ASX:MRD) reports maiden inferred scandium MRE at Mount Ridley: ~368Mt @57.3ppm Sc; massive, strategic resource.

item.title: Horizon Minerals Delivers High-Grade Results from Phase 1 Drilling at Burbanks Gold Project
item.description: Horizon Minerals (ASX:HRZ) delivers high-grade Phase 1 drill results at Burbanks gold project, including 2m at 235.7 g/t Au; resource update due June qtr.
